[[Category:Imperial Sodality]][[Category:388YE Spring]]
==Overview==
The [[Imperial sodality|Imperial sodalities]] of the Empire have potentially far-reaching powers. Each season, the members of Imperial sodalities meet to vote on elections, bequests, and other actions that their sodality might take. 

Where possible, the civil service records these votes and presents the results after each summit. 

==Apothecaries Guild==
===Appointments===
* '''Esmé i Estrico i Erigo''' was appointed as [[Imperial_Apothecaries_Guild#Guild_Leader|Guild Leader of the Apothecaries]]

==Sun Chamber==
===Appointments===
* '''Bartholomew of Cantiarch's Hold''' was appointed as [[Stoat of the Sun]]

===Bequests===
* [[Sun_Chamber#The_Falling_Star|The Falling Star]] (3 rings of ilium) was awarded to '''Thalen Elric''' of [[Dawn]]
* [[Sun_Chamber#The_Line_and_the_Curve|The Line and the Curve]] (25 mana crystals) was awarded to '''Bartholomew of Cantiarch's Hold''' of [[Highguard]]
* [[Sun_Chamber#The_Wyrd_Stone|The Wyrd Stone]] (30 crowns) was awarded to '''Nina of Cantiarch's Hold''' of [[Highguard]]

===Door of the Chamber===
* [[Sun_Chamber#Current Problems|Current Problems]] was chosen
** The Sun Chamber called on its members and former members to appraise protecting resources, constructions and infrastructure in regions threatened by the [[vallorn]]
